messages.content: Help me initiate a shard operation on a searchable snapshot for a specific request `snapshotRequest`, shard routing `shardRouteInfo`, and task `snapshotTask`, and handle the result asynchronously using the listener `operationListener`?

function.name: AbstractTransportSearchableSnapshotsAction_shardOperation
function.description: Executes a shard-level operation on a searchable snapshot, ensuring the license is valid and the directory is correctly unwrapped before performing the operation. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

request.description: The request to perform the shard operation. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

shardRouting.description: The ShardRouting information for the shard on which to perform the operation. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

task.description: The task associated with the shard operation. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

listener.description: The ActionListener that will handle the ShardOperationResult asynchronously. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
